purpose: INSA v0.3 §5 Applicability Declaration for INSA-ID-E1. Per proposal v4 INV-APPL-1, this declaration must be ACTIVE for State, Identity, and Evidence before any pre-execution gate passes.

state.rationale: INSA-ID-E1 exercises the Safe Evolution Contract (§12) which requires state-aware evolution: the executor must commit a consequential change against a frozen pre-mutation state, with freshness evidence captured at the M-commit boundary (INV-AUTH-5). State applies because the experiment is a controlled, state-mutating evolution of a governed intelligent executor against a frozen baseline.

identity.rationale: INSA-ID-E1's preservation model is built on identity-preservation gates (proposal v4 §5.1 INV-P-1, §5.2 subset-(a) and subset-(b)). The frozen identity contract (inputs/identity-contract.txt, blob 7ef4356f657884d65dbd4462d85c1c81b3f6fa2a) is the binding identity basis. Identity applies because the experiment tests whether declared identity dimensions are preserved under a targeted behavioral modification.

evidence.rationale: INSA-ID-E1 produces a per-step evidence profile (proposal v4 §5.1 INV-EVID-1, §14 evidence-chain cross-cut) including locked evaluator scorebooks, raw candidate outputs, and causal-trace per §5.3. Evidence applies because architectural claim verification requires auditable, content-addressed evidence at every consequential step.

INV-D-1, INV-O-1, INV-P-1a, INV-P-1b, INV-V-1, INV-A-1, INV-G-1 all carry pre-mutation SHAs. INV-AUTH-1..8 captured in inputs/authority-manifest.json. INV-EVID-1 captured by content-addressing of all pre-execution artifacts. INV-APPL-1 satisfied by this declaration (State/Identity/Evidence ACTIVE).
